title: 1620 Prairie's terrace runs across its bay window
items: The stone terrace at the head of 1620 Prairie's stoop now runs south as well as north: behind its turned balustrade it crosses in front of the bay window and ends just past the house's corner, where the 1874 engraving draws it.
The board fence the engraving draws level beyond 1620's corner turns out to be the next lot's street fence; 1620's own fence stands behind it.
